entries.name: Toggle
entries.notes: Provider receives a draft Boolean and retains validation and persistence ownership.

entries.name: Integer slider
entries.notes: Minimum, maximum, and step are descriptor-owned and host-validated. Click-to-position and continuous held dragging are runtime-verified.

entries.name: Floating-point slider
entries.notes: Finite range and step values are required by the host. Click-to-position and continuous held dragging are runtime-verified.

entries.name: Choice
entries.notes: The ABI and native session validate choices, but the current SWF deliberately labels them unsupported until labels/options are added to the descriptor contract.

entries.name: Selected-record list/detail collection
entries.notes: The provider publishes stable-ID records with bounded label, summary, detail, disabled, and warning state. Selection is transient provider-owned view state and old page-descriptor sizes remain valid.

entries.name: Bounded text input
entries.notes: Required before the public SDK freezes. Provider supplies length and validation bounds; the host owns editing and rendering.

entries.name: Semantic dynamic widget layout
entries.notes: The capability-gated SDK and renderer emit non-focusable section headers and group two or three consecutive inline actions into one physical row, with header-free and non-inline generated fallbacks for older hosts.

entries.name: Semantic composition C2
entries.notes: An independently negotiated experimental API composes existing stable controls into cards, rows, columns, statuses, provider-evaluated conditions, bounded anchors, and same-page live slots. The host validates series/marker associations against copied live descriptors, serializes immutable selected-page snapshots, renders embedded live cards for pointer/keyboard/controller, and retains a deterministic flat fallback. Later record, context, workflow, progress, and direct-manipulation capabilities remain unadvertised.

entries.name: Host-owned standard widget library
entries.notes: Each component owns rendering, measured layout, focus, pointer hit regions, wheel behavior, and semantic event emission. Subscriber-specific SWFs and native duplicate pixel hitboxes are prohibited.

entries.name: Live range and detent meter
entries.notes: Covers AbsoluteHOTAS throttle/bipolar graphs and Absolute Head Tracking output bars without requiring a general time-series plot.

entries.name: Bounded telemetry plot
entries.notes: Used only when history over time is useful; current-sample axis displays use the cheaper range meter.

entries.name: Segmented allocation grid
entries.notes: Power publishes six dynamic 12-pip rows with direct four-state cycling, high-contrast tier numbers, +G/+Y/+R/- quick steps, long labels, live current state, target preview, keyboard/controller row adjustment, and capability-gated inline priority Choices.

entries.name: Bounded live component channel
entries.notes: Product registry and MenuSession separate immutable configuration snapshots from visible-route live frames, cap payloads, mark stale data, suspend hidden channels, attach compound edits to the page transaction, and explicitly associate same-page Choice controls without changing the committed grid-column stride.

entries.name: Action
entries.notes: Invokes a provider-owned callback without creating a dirty configuration draft.

entries.name: Action confirmation
entries.notes: Capability-gated Actions may request a host-owned label/description confirmation. Cancel never enters provider code; Confirm resumes the Action's existing transaction semantics.

entries.name: Input binding
entries.notes: Keyboard activation waits for its initiating key to be released; provider-owned controller capture remains optional. Duplicate writes or provider Error results open a host-owned Reassign/Cancel modal, and successful reassignment remains inside the ordinary provider draft and Apply/Cancel transaction.

entries.name: Mod sidebar
entries.notes: One compact vertical row per subscriber mod; thirteen mods are visible at once with selection-following overflow.

entries.name: Horizontal page tabs
entries.notes: Only the selected mod's pages appear across the workspace top; six tabs are visible at once with selection-following overflow and Q/R navigation.

entries.name: Control list
entries.notes: Ten compact controls are visible at once with selection-following scrolling; overflowing pages expose a workspace scrollbar. Direction-specific mouse-wheel routing is implemented, but a clean final two-direction runtime regression remains pending.

entries.name: Input-aware command footer
entries.notes: Apply, Cancel, and Close/Back are compact device-aware prompts and clickable footer targets. Dirty pages block cross-page navigation; Cancel rolls provider state back. Current Close automatically cancels a dirty page; the target confirmation modal is not implemented.

entries.name: Absolute Control Panel Scaleform movie
entries.provenance: Source-built with pinned Apache Flex 4.16.1 and playerglobal commit recorded in build metadata.

entries.name: Embedded pixel glyph set
entries.notes: Code-defined uppercase glyphs avoid external font dependencies but have known alignment and typography limits.

entries.name: Additive PauseMenu entry
entries.readiness: After Starfield completes active-menu insertion, install an enterFrame callback on that PauseMenu movie. The callback waits for entryCount to be greater than zero and no more than 32, then clones the vanilla entries and appends one Control Panel action on Scaleform's advance path.
entries.failurePolicy: Bounded 180-frame event-driven wait, fail closed, opt-in unbound recovery hotkey; no background Scaleform polling.
entries.notes: Validated without replacing pausemenu.swf in both a heavily modified profile and the isolated baseline. The lifecycle-owned revision completed 25 consecutive opens on one retained save, including a Control Panel show/hide followed by five more cycles: 25/25 boundaries, listeners, injections, and completions; one Scaleform thread; zero timeouts, rejections, errors, crashes, or new dumps.

entries.name: Native GameMenuBase registration
entries.notes: Dedicated native menu owns its Scaleform movie and does not replace the vanilla pause menu.

entries.name: Absolute Control host management
entries.notes: Release and ResearchDev register the same last-position host module through the public provider ABI. Menu owns registration/alphabetical ordering and safe Pause Menu/F1-F12 activation. Registry reports configuration, live-component, and semantic-composition subscribers without claiming visibility into daughter-module internal buses.

entries.name: Absolute Head Tracking
entries.notes: First public-API subscriber; its runtime-verified settings are now arranged as General, a twelve-control scrollable Axes page, and Bindings. Host-owned single-key and modifier-chord capture remain unchanged.

entries.name: AbsoluteZero
entries.notes: Independent one-page subscriber used with Absolute Head Tracking to observe multi-mod discovery, vertical sidebar navigation, and page-tab isolation in game. The exact subscriber artifact and persistence transcript were not retained, so confidence remains build-verified.

entries.name: Absolute Power
entries.notes: Fail-optional product-query subscriber. The compact Presets surface uses structured sections, inline lifecycle actions, keyboard/Input Bus bindings, and six explicitly row-associated priority Choices around a six-row 12-pip grid. Earlier ResearchDev runs confirmed three-page registration, native movie load, bridge readiness, and publication; current-layout visual and in-game persistence acceptance remain pending.

entries.name: Keyboard chord encoding
entries.notes: An empty string clears a binding when the descriptor is marked clearable.

entries.name: Declarative menu definition
entries.notes: Strict ABI-v1 JSON generates deterministic module, page, and control descriptors plus provider callback mapping. Unknown presentation fields fail; provider callbacks and persistence remain authoritative. Unsupported future semantics are rejected instead of degraded.
